timeline.text: Every week, a teacher's homework plan landed as a PDF, buried in an email no kid could open.
To see it on TV, a parent had to dig it out and show it on a phone.
Now Cloudflare watches that email for the PDF and turns every page into a picture.
Tap the calendar, pick a week, and the real plan appears — swipe through it like a book.
Four boys, four calendars, each one opening its own week, no phone required.
